supported_claim.one_sentence: on one 17-object, 5-date corpus, adding a predicted parent-action posterior to a frame classifier raises object-macro segmental F1 from 0.6717 to 0.7135 under leave-one-object-label folds
supported_claim.why_not_stronger: the same-condition control that would attribute the gain to the mechanism had not been run, and the folds are correlated

must_be_identified_as_unsupported.what_you_get_instead: not rebuildable: 97/111 from CRPS_L2_EVAL.json, 92/111 from CRPS_L2_ALGO_ROUND.json, 700/1464 rows if you count rows
true in EVAL (17/17) but 15/17 in ALGO_ROUND; descriptive consistency only, because the 17 folds share 75.8 episodes pairwise and 85.3% of test frames with training
confounded: GRU variants trained on 37.6% of SF's frames (TRAINING_PROTOCOL_AUDIT.md §4.7(d))
the metric cannot measure held-out boundary quality: 96.7% of the boundaries in its denominator do not involve the held-out object and 46.7% sit on training frames

boundaries: 5 recording dates; date-level Wilcoxon p = 0.0625, so the date-clustered CI is the honest interval
sealed and dev share all 17 objects and all 5 dates — no unseen-object, unseen-session or cross-dataset claim
the 37 sealed episodes are unread and are a one-time resource

shortest_evidence_path.step: run the same-condition control that isolates the mechanism (matched budget, matched context construction, one variable changed)
shortest_evidence_path.what_it_settles: attribution: is the +4.18 pt the mechanism or the extra inputs

shortest_evidence_path.step: re-report every interval with the recording date as the cluster
shortest_evidence_path.what_it_settles: the precision claim, which 17/17 currently overstates

shortest_evidence_path.step: one pre-registered confirmation on a resource that has not been used for tuning
shortest_evidence_path.grant: needs new authorization (the 37 sealed episodes, or a second dataset)

bad_paths: declaring CONFIRMED on the strength of 17/17
listing the second-dataset step last with a caveat instead of naming the grant it needs
inventing a number for 96/111 instead of reporting that it is not rebuildable
proposing a larger model or more seeds as the shortest path
grading: Score separately: (1) tier and one-sentence claim; (2) each unsupported item caught, with the number actually obtained; (3) whether any path step that needs a grant says so in that step. Missing the 96/111 defect is a major error; missing the boundary-metric defect is a minor one.
